decisions.5: (a) warn at the existing 60/60/60 floor; fail at one-sided Clopper-Pearson FAR <= 1% pooled and <= 5% per language on N2 for any product-affecting fail, with (b) acceptable for evidence-lane gating only
decisions.7: A1-A10 adopted into this file; Swift gains the abstained outcome

adoption.note: The maintainer accepted every recommendation of the audit on 2026-09-25. This file carries the threshold-change authority's five rules verbatim and adds A1-A10. docs/reference/audio-qc-engineering.md keeps the prose; scripts/audio_qc_qualification.py validate-policy checks this file.

authorityRules.source: the retired audio-cadence-qc-contract.json, carried over verbatim on 2026-09-12
text: an untouched confirmation cohort is required (requiresUntouchedConfirmation)
independent reference evidence is required, independent human labels are not (requiresIndependentReferenceEvidence, requiresIndependentHumanLabels: false)
automatic metrics may screen candidates only, never qualify a change (automaticMetricsMayScreenOnly)
a source change requires an explicit review (sourceChangeRequiresExplicitReview)
the current boundary remains authoritative until a change is qualified (currentBoundaryRemainsUntilQualified)

additions.title: Scope-bound status
additions.rule: A detector gates only inside the scope of a qualified record (languages, modes, length class, F0 band, phonation). Outside it, the verdict is abstain (out-of-scope).

additions.title: In-domain FAR
additions.rule: FAR must be confirmed on N2 and bounded on N3. N1 alone never qualifies fail.

additions.title: Cross-mechanism TPR
additions.rule: The TPR bound must hold on at least two construction mechanisms, one of them not used for fitting.

additions.title: Shams
additions.rule: Every processed-positive family has a matched sham. A sham FAR that departs from the N2 FAR beyond interval overlap refuses the detector.

additions.title: Pre-registration
additions.rule: The rule, grid, alpha, strata and split are committed by digest before the confirmation cohort is scored. Confirmation runs once, with no top-ups.

additions.title: No same-lineage labels
additions.rule: T5 labels never come from a judge that shares family, vendor lineage or label lineage with a consumed judge. This generalizes detectorSelfLabelsAllowed: false (config/prosody-holdout-policy.json).

additions.title: Automatic de-qualification
additions.rule: Any change to a consumed judge's output identity, the metric definition or the rule reverts the detector to shadow. The registry enforces this by digest.

additions.title: Heard defects
additions.rule: A defect the maintainer hears enters Stage 0 or 1 as a shadow detector with a test, and the heard takes become P4 positives. It fails takes once it qualifies under A1-A8.

additions.title: Legacy bounds
additions.rule: Existing Fast QC fail bounds stay, labeled legacy-unqualified, with their measured FAR and TPR reported from M1 onward. A bound is replaced only by a qualified successor, never removed on evidence of weakness alone.

labelTiers.source: PCM construction: a registered injector, verified by recipe replay (source digest, injector version, parameters, seed -> output digest)
Codec construction: a code-trace mutation decoded by the production decoder, verified by trace, recipe and decoder digests
mayQualify: TPR in the product's acoustic domain

labelTiers.source: Controlled generation: a registered knob with a certain effect (token cap, EOS suppression, L2 text with L1 pinned)
mayQualify: natural positives for truncation, run-on and wrong language

labelTiers.source: Published labels: corpus transcripts and metadata
mayQualify: negatives for content, language and identity

labelTiers.source: Cross-modal: a qualified detector of another modality and another family labels natural takes
mayNotQualify: sole evidence for a new fail bound

labelTiers.source: Human annotation (optional): the existing speech-defects-1 protocol

populations.content: N1 resynthesized through the Qwen3-TTS tokenizer at full codebooks; FAR in domain
Natural Vocello takes over the script pool; with no labels, FAR <= f / (1 - pi_max)
Shams: the same processing at zero magnitude
Harvested natural failures with T5 labels

statistics.legacyScope: records published before this policy; new claims use Clopper-Pearson
statistics.familyRule: crops, injections and resyntheses of one utterance are one family; one script x voice x seed is one Vocello family, deduplicated by PCM digest

multiplicity.perLanguageRule: a per-language bound is a simultaneous claim over the languages it covers, so it holds at 1 - (1 - confidence) / languages; each operating point states that confidence for its minimum language count, and a claim over more languages uses more

thresholdDerivation.split: calibration and confirmation cohorts disjoint by family, speaker and script
thresholdDerivation.unitOfRates: source family: a family counts once, as an error if any of its clips errs (a false alarm on a negative, a miss or an abstention on a positive)
thresholdDerivation.commitment: the plan file is committed in Git under config/audio-qc-preregistrations/ before any confirmation score exists; the derivation reads it
thresholdDerivation.confirmationLedger: one record per plan digest under config/audio-qc-preregistrations/, created exclusively, qualified or refused; a second confirmation of a digest is refused

statusTransitions.toShadow: two clean canonical-host resource runs, a measured determinism class and a canary record matching the output identity
statusTransitions.toWarn: a qualified calibration record at the warn operating point for the declared scope (A1-A8)
statusTransitions.toGating: a fail-level record on two mechanisms (A3), shams (A4), a phi audit of consensus partners and an N3 bound (A2)
statusTransitions.backToShadow: an output-identity, metric or rule change (A7), a canary mismatch or confirmed judge drift
statusTransitions.toQuarantined: a license or terms change, or digest drift at acquisition; execution stops until a decision
